profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Distributed Systems Developer

summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing high-throughput distributed systems and modern web applications. Proven track record leading architecture modernizations, optimizing database latency, and mentoring junior engineers in clean code and TDD.

bullets: Architected telemetry analytics ingestion pipeline processing 45,000 events/sec with sub-second dashboard rendering.
Refactored relational query layer with partitioned caching, reducing p99 API latency from 420ms to 85ms.
Spearheaded automated schema contract tests in CI, eliminating breaking database regressions across 14 services.
Engineered scalable REST and WebSocket microservices in TypeScript handling 20,000 concurrent client connections.
Automated deployment workflows with containerized pipelines, decreasing release failure rate by 65%.
Authored internal documentation and developer quickstart guides for core SDK components.

details: Graduated Magna Cum Laude; Dean's Honors List for six semesters.
Capstone: Distributed Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus implementation.

projects.name: FastKV Memory Cache
bullets: Constructed zero-dependency in-memory key-value cache with LRU eviction and atomic file snapshotting.
Benchmarked throughput reaching 1.2M operations/second on multi-core test fixtures.
